what_it_supports: WhiteLabel plan: $130/mo flat platform fee + $7 per hotel property + $0.50 per vacation-rental unit, volume discounts (hotels $6 at 500+, $5 at 1000+, $4 at 2000+); ONLY properties with at least one active channel are billed; no setup fee, no minimum contract, 30 days notice to cancel; overage above 20 room types or 200 rate plans per hotel; optional Chat & Reviews $7/hotel; optional Stripe tokenisation $0.02/txn. Target customers: commercial PMS vendors, booking-engine and RMS providers, and HOTEL GROUPS BUILDING IN-HOUSE SYSTEMS; explicitly NOT a fit for a single hotel or a team without development resources (API-only). Sells WHOLESALE ONLY, does not sell to hotels. White-label covers interface, API responses and documentation. FREE staging at staging.channex.io, no card required, full API. Certification: get API access + staging account, create property/room types/rate plans, send ARI, receive bookings, then pass certification = efficiency check + correct endpoint usage + LIVE SCREEN-SHARE with the Channex team; going live also requires OTA account authorisation. Listings are created on the OTA then connected to Channex. ARI: availability, rates, restrictions incl. min stay and closed dates. Inbound: new, modified and cancelled reservations. LIMITATION: generally CANNOT change dates or cancel an OTA reservation through Channex (some channel-specific actions exist, e.g. reporting a no-show to Booking.com). Listing creation and content updates NOT currently supported (Booking.com/Airbnb listing creation is a 2027 roadmap target, not a commitment). Delivery: webhook HTTPS POST expecting 200 OK, AND poll the Booking Revisions Feed every 15-20 minutes as backup, acknowledging each revision AFTER saving. States GDPR compliance. 77+ OTA and booking channels claimed
reliability_notes: Direct fetch of an official machine-readable index, corroborated by the official pricing pages. The most detailed and most actionable provider evidence in this entire research set, and the only provider that documents a free sandbox and an explicit delivery/acknowledgement protocol. DOES NOT state who owns the data or the hotel relationship -- that sits in the Customer Agreement at channex.io/policy, unread. Third-party price claims of ~$29-30/mo (Aiosell, Capterra) contradict the official $130 platform fee and should be treated as stale or a different tier
